title: test(form): CI unit tests for ModalForm/DrawerForm subform hosting
body:
Locks the master-detail entry-point wiring into CI. The ModalForm/DrawerForm subform-hosting behavior (#1529/#1530) was previously covered only by opt-in live e2e (not run in CI). Adds unit tests:

- `ModalForm` with `subforms` renders `MasterDetailForm` inside the dialog (`md-form-submit` + child section visible, plain `modal-form-footer` suppressed).
- `DrawerForm` with `subforms` renders `MasterDetailForm` inside the drawer.
- `ModalForm` without `subforms` renders a normal form (footer present, no `md-form-submit`).

**80 plugin-form tests pass.** Test-only; no behavior change.
